macros.name: addbox
macros.doc: This macro specifies a horizontal box whose height and depth are adjusted using the given values.

macros.name: bstrut
macros.doc: The \tstrut, \bstrut, and \tbstrut commands insert struts exceeding the height, depth, and both height and depth of the strut prototype \Strutletter by a special small amount.

macros.name: cbox
macros.doc: The \cbox/⟨value⟩/[⟨pos⟩]{⟨body⟩} command prepares a box whose body is a one-column table.

macros.name: cboxstyle
macros.doc: The \cboxstyle specifies a style applied to all \cbox commands.

macros.name: jparbox
macros.doc: The \jparbox vertically aligns paragraph box with respect to a prototype.

macros.name: pbox
macros.doc: The \pbox is a simple version of one-column table.

macros.name: tbstrut

macros.name: tc
macros.doc: To center a table field, the \tc{⟨field⟩} command is introduced since version 1.2 of the package.
